method.api: brute.certify/11: method 'betting' is new; 'stitched' = /10, 'lr' = /9, 'anytime' = /8, unchanged. /10 to /1 carried.
method.definition: Maintain a predictable-plug-in betting confidence sequence (hedged capital process, alpha = delta/2) for the flip rate eps on observed mismatches under the leading hypothesis; at each step use its upper end eps_hat_u (capped at eps_bar) in place of eps_bar in the RGL4 LR threshold at confidence delta/2. Same family bound, burn-in, eps_bar 0.02 and total delta 0.01 as RGL4.
method.lemma_first: An exact lemma (betting CS validity at alpha=delta/2 plus the LR test at delta/2 union to delta, under iid flips with eps <= eps_bar independent of actions and mask) and a DP reference implementation are committed and ledgered before any RGB6 code.

motivation: Study-024 (Observed): stitching the LR bound across epochs kept RGL5 sound on the noisy main set (0/240 false, CP95 0.0124) but added only +0.0076 [0.0032, 0.0128] late coverage over RGL4 and trailed the planned-B margin RGNB4 by 0.036 and the oracle by 0.417 (ratio 0.501). The bound's price is now in the union over epochs and in the worst-case eps_bar, not in the horizon. The oracle gap (Inferred) is mostly the cost of not knowing eps. v0.22.0 tests whether a betting confidence sequence for the flip rate, used to set an eps-adaptive LR margin, closes part of that gap without losing soundness.
